scientific_integrity: All statements concern a binary two-sided finite-type shift. A fully specified exact integer verifier is included. The existing general pseudoperiod theorem and finite-state methods are credited.
scientific_limitations: The fixed triple only; other triples are not classified. Possible equivalent four-forbidden-factor presentations remain an originality risk. Matrix certificate is exact but has not been independently audited.
title: Golden-ratio entropy and exact periodic-orbit law for the binary \((1,3,4)\)-pseudoperiod shift
